scenes.vo: The transaction is not the crime. The network is. Suspicious activity hides in the hops around a payment, not in the wire itself. Corridor Watch takes the network as the case. One synthetic case shows the path.

A rule on one transaction flags the wrong object. Cross-border mule and layering rings are not a single wire. Funds can arrive, rest for minutes, and leave under another purpose. A threshold cannot see that shared device. The bank is left an alert, and no memory of the network.
Corridor Watch turns one alert into a defensible decision. Investigate the corridor. Preserve the evidence. Keep the decision human.

This console is the middle bank, BANK S G. Case C W mid zero two is nine thousand fifty dollars, Singapore to the Philippines, risk ninety-one, mule pass-through. The queue marks it partial. The badge reads partial network observed. Visibility sixty-one percent is coverage, not guilt. Eighteen minutes earlier, C W mid zero one brought nine thousand two hundred dollars in from India, on shared device D mid mule. The object under review is the corridor.

Corridor Watch constructs that corridor before a model speaks. A twelve-step investigation builds the evidence pack: the payment, both profiles, risk features, shared devices, and the neighborhood. Then it drafts a deterministic verdict. On this case the pill is high, ninety-one. The next step is a human decision, not an automatic clear. Downstream of the Philippines hop, the graph keeps an unknown boundary. It does not invent a bank.

Follow the money across institutions — including the boundaries you cannot see. Observed path: India to Singapore to the Philippines. The shared mule device links the accounts. Downstream, Bank H K remains unresolved.

The model does not see the raw ledger. It receives that evidence pack. It explains only what the pack supports: why the case looks this way, what is still unknown, and what a person should check next. Every claim must cite evidence. If the grounding gate rejects a claim, the deterministic verdict stands. High. Ninety-one.

The A I recommends pause for an F I U lead. A named human authorizes. Hold payment, escalate, and freeze stay with the lead. Here the lead records hold payment. That is human authorization in this console — not a core-banking freeze. Recommendation is not authorization.

A confirming decision writes Crime Pattern DNA. This network strengthens the multi-hop layering fingerprint in the library. Confirmed investigations become reusable memory for the next case. The next network can match that fingerprint.
The transaction is not the crime. The network is. Corridor Watch turns investigations into institutional memory. Investigate the corridor. Preserve the evidence. Keep the decision human.
